chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Faddal, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a cow offered as sacrifice. He said: It suffices for seven.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A title of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْبَقَرَةِ: a cow used here as a sacrificial animal

ai.seo_question: For how many people does one cow suffice in the sacrificial offering?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding sacrificial worship at Mina. It states that one cow offered as udhiyah is sufficient on behalf of seven people.
